excerpt: All support services  Six NDIS registration groups, one team
NDIS registered provider · Available across Australia, with our largest worker pools in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane
Employed, never contractors  Every worker is our employee — insured, screened and paid properly under the SCHADS Award.
We focus on the everyday supports that make the biggest difference — funded under six NDIS registration groups.
We deliberately focus on the everyday supports that make the biggest difference — delivered by workers you choose, funded under six NDIS registration groups.

Delivered under registration group  0102 — Assistance to Access and Maintain Employment , usually from your  Capacity Building  (Finding & Keeping a Job) budget. Your exact support item and agreed price are confirmed before support begins.
Delivered under registration group  0107 — Assistance with Daily Personal Activities , from your  Core  budget (Assistance with Daily Life).

Delivered under registration group  0108 — Assistance with Travel/Transport arrangements , typically from your  Core  budget. Worker time is billed at our standard rates; a per-kilometre vehicle allowance applies when your worker drives.

Delivered under registration groups  0115 — Assistance with Daily Life Tasks in a Group or Shared Living Arrangement  and  0138 — Supported Independent Living  (added to our registration from 1 July 2026), from your  Core  budget (Assistance with Daily Life).
Delivered under registration group  0120 — Household Tasks , from your  Core  budget. Where your plan uses the dedicated house-cleaning line item, we bill at or below its limit.
Delivered under registration group  0125 — Participation in Community, Social and Civic Activities , usually from your  Core  budget (Assistance with Social, Economic and Community Participation).
NDIA-managed  — as a registered provider we claim through the NDIA portal, so agency-managed participants aren't locked out like they are on unregistered platforms.
Your worker earns  $53.35 /hr   Including 12% super — 72.5% of your rate on day one, rising to 76.5%. Never below the SCHADS Award.

A 2-hour booking minimum applies, in line with SCHADS minimum-engagement rules — the exact price is always shown before you confirm. Sleepovers are billed at the NDIS night-time sleepover rate of  $311.79 per night  (includes up to 2 hours of active support; extra active hours at the applicable hourly rate). House-cleaning-only bookings are billed at  $60.10/hr  — the NDIA's dedicated published maximum for Household Tasks. Employment support (010
Registration group  Support  Claims against
$53.35 (72.5%)  — your worker's pay and super on day one, rising to $56.29 (76.5%). Never below the SCHADS Award.

Rates sit above the SCHADS Award for comparable classifications, and include the 12% superannuation guarantee — on weekdays the starting $53.35/hr is $47.63/hr cash plus $5.72 super.  Sleepovers:  you receive the SCHADS sleepover allowance, plus at least four hours of rostered work or pay immediately before or after the sleepover; any work performed during the sleepover is paid at the applicable overtime rate, with a minimum payment of one hour.

On a few supports the published maximum price is low enough that a percentage of it would fall under the SCHADS minimum for your classification. When that happens we pay the Award, not the share — and your payslip says which one you got.

The NDIS Practice Standards set out eight  high intensity daily personal activities  in Supplementary Module 1, registration group  0104 . They are the supports where getting it wrong is a clinical event rather than a bad shift, so a provider has to be assessed against a separate standard for each one before it can deliver it.

In plain language, structured to the Australian Privacy Principles — the formal wording is being settled with our legal reviewer before launch.

Why we use it.  To create and run your account, match and roster workers safely, deliver and record supports, process NDIS or private payments, meet our obligations as a registered provider (worker screening, incidents, complaints), and improve the service.
Complaints.  Contact privacy@thecareweb.com.au first. If you're not satisfied, you can complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (oaic.gov.au).

Support workers are employees of Disability & Mental Health Care Pty Ltd — paid under the SCHADS Award with superannuation, covered by workers' compensation and insurance, screened before their profile goes live, and supported with training that stays current.

Why: these eight sit in registration group  0104  (high intensity daily personal activities). Disability & Mental Health Care is registered for  0107  personal activities and not for 0104, and under the Registration Rules a provider must not deliver a support its certificate doesn't carry.
Rates shown align with the  NDIS Pricing Arrangements and Price Limits 2026–27 .
